enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with fan on for heat relief
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Turns body to left side. Pulls blanket up to chest. Adjusts fan speed with remote. Turns body to right side. Pushes blanket down. Turns onto back. Places arm over forehead. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket over shoulder. Adjusts pillow. Turns onto stomach. Bends knee. Stretches arm. Turns onto back. Sits up. Lies back down. Closes eyes.

Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Turns on tap. Adjusts water temperature. Wets hands. Picks up soap. Rubs hands together. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Spits into sink. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Dries hands with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs, milk, butter. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl. Closes cupboard. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds butter to pan. Pours eggs into pan. Scrambles eggs. Turns off cooker. Places eggs on plate. Opens refrigerator. Takes out juice. Closes refrigerator. Pours juice into glass. Sits at table. Eats eggs. Drinks juice. Washes dishes. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone for work emails
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Closes wardrobe. Opens drawer. Takes out pants. Closes drawer. Puts on shirt. Buttons shirt. Puts on pants. Zips pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens email app. Scrolls through emails. Reads emails. Types reply. Sends reply. Places phone in pocket. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Swipes transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Steps off bus. Walks to office building. Enters building. Walks to elevator. Presses button. Waits for elevator. Enters elevator. Presses floor button. Exits elevator. Walks to office door. Opens door. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator at nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens email. Reads emails. Types replies. Answers phone. Takes notes. Attends meeting. Speaks in meeting. Writes on whiteboard. Returns to desk. Opens document. Types report. Makes phone calls. Prints documents. Files papers. Organizes schedule. Checks calendar. Updates database. Turns off computer.

Walks to elevator. Presses button. Waits for elevator. Enters elevator. Presses ground floor button. Exits elevator. Walks to exit. Opens door. Steps outside. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Swipes transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Steps off bus. Walks home. Enters home.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables, chicken. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out cutting board. Closes cupboard. Picks up knife. Cuts vegetables. Cuts chicken. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Adds vegetables and chicken. Stirs. Turns off cooker. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Washes dishes. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, reading, and using computer with fan on to avoid AC peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on fan. Sits on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns pages. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Picks up computer. Opens laptop. Presses power button. Waits for boot. Opens browser. Types website. Scrolls. Watches video. Types message. Sends message. Closes laptop. Adjusts fan. Lies down. Closes eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on air conditioner. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Sits on sofa. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Places phone down. Gets up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Closes refrigerator. Returns to sofa. Sits down. Drinks. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Turns off air conditioner.

Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Lathers. Rinses. Picks up shampoo. Applies shampoo. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Walks to sink. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Turns off tap. Dries face. Turns off light. Walks out.

Enters bedroom. Turns on fan. Lies on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Pushes blanket down. Turns onto back. Places arm over eyes. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket over shoulder. Turns onto stomach. Bends knee. Stretches arm. Turns onto back. Sits up. Lies back down. Closes eyes.
